upstream_api_review.spec_delta_from_previous_binding: Additive over 0.9.0-rc.18: the client subset grows from 116 to 117 operations and the full specification from 385 to 386. New POST /media/studio-counts counts the visible works of up to 200 studio names and 200 groups of names (1..20 each, 1000 names in all) in one request: each name row equals the total of GET /media?studios=<that name> and each group row the total of GET /media?studios=<all its names> (a work counted once), with the same library_id and media_type, in request order. The studios filter of GET /media, /media/initials and /media/ids takes \, for a comma inside a name and \\ for a backslash; any other backslash stays literal. Capability features add media_studio_counts; new schemas StudioCountsRequest, StudioCountsGroup, StudioCount, StudioCountsGroupResult and StudioCounts; no new limits. No typed SDK schema change.
